section_starts_with: 64. Expeditious disposal of applications. - (1) Where an application
authored_by: Claude Code, on your instruction of 2026-10-07 (D-045); not reviewed by a lawyer
notes: The section binds both the NCLT and the NCLAT; the frozen format holds one forum_level, so NCLT_ORIGINAL is used. Reviewer: confirm or change.

statutory_summary: Where an application is not disposed of or an order is not passed within the period specified in this Code
shall record the reasons for not doing so within the period so specified
may, after taking into account the reasons so recorded, extend the period specified in the Act but not exceeding ten days

No injunction shall be granted by any court, tribunal or authority in respect of any action taken, or to be taken, in pursuance of any power conferred on the National Company Law Tribunal or the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal under this Code
